node.title: Re^4: You won't believe what this regular expression does!
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But please note the second fOO

Yes, good point! I think the main question is what the intent of the regex is. If it's "replace any o's at the end of each line", then the better solution is, [id://11128785|as you said], /o+$/, and using o* is the "mistake".
